{{Quote|I am Trizz'mal the Merciless. My ship is the terror of the skies on twenty planets.|Trizz'mal|<ref name="Score" />}}
'''Trizz'mal the Merciless''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he became an officer of the [[Voidwolf's personal strike fleet]] and later volunteered to command it, boasting that his ship was the terror in the skies over twenty [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. After a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] killed the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf]], Trizz'mal pledged himself to the newly proclaimed [[Voidhound]]. However, he died in the following fight with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] fleet.<ref name="Score" />

==Behind the scenes==
If the player chooses [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] options and orders captains to attack the Empire, Trizz'mal dies in battle. Otherwise, he survives.<ref name="Score" />
